note: Shared Ground Stop advisory (ADVZY) reference cases. Transcribed from the vATCSCC TMI reference PDF cited by VATUSA/OIS#437 (the 'TMIs' document, 4 example advisories: GDP 002, Ground Stop 003, Reroute 004/005). The renderer is backend/src/advisory.rs (render_ground_stop). Same rules as gdp-reference.json: the backend is authoritative, every field is written out, and deviations are recorded per case.

cases.name: advzy-003-ground-stop
cases.why: The reference Ground Stop, every field populated. The three delay triplets are the point: CURRENT, PREVIOUS and NEW each print TOTAL/MAXIMUM/AVERAGE, and swapping two of those labels would change what a controller reads off the document while every other test stayed green. FLT INCL carries its mode inline here -- `(Manual) ZHU ...` -- which is why values print as typed rather than through `clean`: upper-casing would make it `(MANUAL)`.
cases.deviation: One, as in the GDP case: the source's two blank lines before the period line are rendered as one, matching the other two types.
